tasks.check: grep -q 'PILOT_LOADED n=10' monitor.txt || { echo 'FAIL: pilot list did not load 10 patients'; head -3 monitor.txt; exit 1; }; grep -q 'MONITOR_END' monitor.txt || { echo 'FAIL: monitor did not run to its end time'; tail -3 monitor.txt; exit 1; }; test "$(grep -c '^CYCLE ' monitor.txt)" -ge 10 || { echo 'FAIL: fewer than 10 monitoring cycles'; exit 1; }; echo "MEASURED: $(tail -2 monitor.txt | head -1)"
